{
  "correction_rules": [
    "Adjust forecasts downward when sentiment is neutral or negative (sentiment ≤ 0.00) to counteract overconfidence.",
    "Increase forecast lag by 1-2 days if recent history shows strong upward momentum and sentiment is positive, to avoid overshoot.",
    "Apply mean reversion bias: if forecast is > 5% above recent 7-day average, reduce by 10-15% for next period.",
    "Reduce forecast magnitude by 5-10% if true outcome exceeds model forecast by > 10% in 3 consecutive days, indicating overestimation.",
    "If sentiment is positive (≥ 0.25) and forecast is below true outcome, increase forecast by 5-10% to align with bullish momentum.",
    "For high volatility periods (e.g., > 15% daily swings), apply smoothing filter to reduce noise and avoid erratic spikes.",
    "When true outcome is consistently higher than forecast, especially after a spike, assume model underestimates demand — increase forecast by 5-10% for next period."
  ]
}
